content.doc_md:
❮ Java Keywords

Thefinalkeyword is a non-access modifier used for classes, attributes and methods, which makes them non-changeable (impossible to inherit or override).

Thefinalkeyword is useful when you want a variable to always store the same value, like PI (3.14159...).

Thefinalkeyword is called a "modifier". You will learn more about these in theJava Modifiers Chapter.

Read more about attributes ourJava Class Attributes Tutorial.
